dependency.rule: Code: the derived.py functions from the state to output, p and the pressures (PRESSURE_PATH) read none of FORBIDDEN, and no GI contributor reads a derived quantity. Numbers: on the validation sample (the first, middle and last retained unit at each demand, every scenario, both cases), full runs at demand 1.0 and 1.1, at the unit's lactate-side point and another, under the primary HR profile with its highest gains and ceiling 150, intrinsic upper, and under the default profile's diagnostic pressure term, give the blood-only run's output, p, SBP, DBP and MAP exactly, while D differs with demand.

rule.1: falling output at fixed T never raises MAP: P6 and every consecutive minute pair of every trajectory (T = 1)
rule.2: rising output at fixed T never lowers MAP: the same pairs
rule.3: more tone at fixed output never lowers MAP: P5 fixed-output probes, every afterload point
rule.4: zero output never preserves a normal pressure: P7 (numerical zero with a pulse stops the run; MAP below 1 mmHg at output 1e-6 even at the tone bound 3; no pulse, no pressure)
rule.5: untreated haemorrhage never normalizes pressure on its own: P1, MAP never above the arrival MAP in minutes 1-120, every blood set
rule.6: effective resuscitation may improve pressure: P4, MAP at 120 above arrival on at least one blood set (reachability, counted)
rule.7: haemostasis alone forces no instantaneous normalization: with h the minute the GI module records the source controlled (its step into h already bleeds at the residual rate), P4 equals P3 before h, and P4's MAP step into h is no larger than its largest one-minute step before h, every blood set; the haemostasis minute's own effect, MAP_P4(h) - MAP_P3(h), is reported
rule.8: the pressure response to fluid or blood arises through physiology, not treatment identity: every minute MAP = MAP_arrival x output x T exactly, and arterial_pressures reads only p and the arrival anchors

faculty.correction: the minimum common-physiology correction of a clear structural defect; no fit to the two GI pressures, no GI-specific term, no unnecessary change to output, no new parameter unless structurally required (then stop for authorization before any range)
faculty.demand: 1.0 and 1.1 stay CURRENTLY_COMPATIBLE uncertainty states; robustness across them is not required; pressure is simulated once if it is invariant to demand
faculty.hr: P2I-2AK accepted (HR_OBSERVABLE_FILTER_SATISFIED); the HR region is carried as uncertainty: no intrinsic rate, acute-deficit gain, debt gain or sinus ceiling is selected or approved
faculty.pressure_to_hr: PRESSURE_TERM_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: the pressure contribution to the sympathetic drive stays 0 in the primary HR profile until pressure is structurally coherent and a later package reconnects it
faculty.scope: shadow only; no runtime integration, GI or second-family migration, final pressure parameter, hard pressure envelope, pressure -> HR reconnection, RR calibration, collapse, legacy fitting or HR latent selection
faculty.structure: pressure continuous in output; never decreasing with output at a fixed tone or with tone at a fixed output; approaching zero with output; no arbitrary positive floor without output; consistent with pulse, rhythm and arrest. A smooth nonlinear mapping is acceptable; a physiologically meaningful knee may be later; an arbitrary implementation discontinuity is not

identifiability_rule: WELL_CONSTRAINED: fixed by the observations; PARTIALLY_CONSTRAINED: narrowed, not fixed; POORLY_IDENTIFIED: several values fit; NON_IDENTIFIABLE: no observation reaches it. Two authored pressures (one per case, at arrival, where the model reproduces them by construction) are the only pressure observations. No best set is chosen.
normalization: Before P2J-1, MIXED: SBP and DBP in absolute mmHg, anchored on the authored arrival with absolute legacy gains, while p and the HR term are relative to arrival, and 1 - p did not equal the relative MAP deficit (the linear branch moved MAP by 31.7 mmHg per unit of p, about half of MAP_arrival). Since P2J-1, ABSOLUTE_MMHG_ANCHORED_ON_AUTHORED_ARRIVAL: SBP, DBP and MAP are absolute, clinically interpretable mmHg whose scale is the authored arrival pressure, and MAP / MAP_arrival = p exactly, so the relative pressure the HR term reads is the displayed MAP's deficit from arrival. No normal (euvolaemic) pressure is declared by either case, so none is invented: a baroreflex set point is a faculty number (BAROREFLEX_PLAN).
policy: Shadow only. P2I-2AK's committed record and the P2I-2AJ / P2I-2AK machinery; legacy pressure never read (no shadow, legacy adapter or family-engine import), the P2F region never consumed (P2FGuard), no hard pressure envelope, nothing approved or selected, pressure -> HR not reconnected.
range_rule: Built before any trajectory: the registered band of the only pressure-domain parameter left (afterload sensitivity 0.1 / 0.3 / 0.5, calibration.REGISTRY), its dimensional limit (a < 1, so output stays positive and pressure rises with tone), the authored arrival pressures as the mapping's scale and the synthetic probes. No GI trajectory and no legacy pressure is read to choose it. No hard pressure envelope exists beyond arrival, so no pressure filter is applied.

tone.rule: Every read and write of the tone channel in clinical_core, found on the syntax tree: an attribute .T, a keyword T= (evolve), Channel.T, or a drift on channel "T". A writer outside a synthetic probe, a test or a bound is a clinical writer. T is relative systemic vascular resistance when it is the only resistance pressure reads (implicit resistance 1 everywhere) and it lowers output only through afterload; MIXED_CONSTRUCT when the pressure mapping carries a resistance of its own.

verdict.rule: READY when the pressure mapping is CONTINUOUS_AND_SMOOTH, non-decreasing, 0 at 0 and with implicit resistance 1; T's paths are enumerated and it has no clinical writer; zero output and arrest hold (P7); no floor or knee remains; the arrival reconstruction is available for both cases; the candidate surface is the frozen one, with every afterload point below 1 and admissible on the P5 probes; the upstream physiology is unchanged (the lactate units reproduce P2I-2AK's digests, derived.py and shadow.py are P2I-2AK's outside the statements P2J-1 declares, pressure equals across demand, lactate side and HR profile); HR feedback stays deferred (the primary profile's pressure term 0); and directions 1-5, 7 and 8 hold. Otherwise NOT_READY with the first failing check as the blocker.
